div.div: Reading path ① Speed, torque, halt and brake commands reach the host. ② The datapath turns the torque command into phase drive: PID, CORDIC, inverse Park and Clarke, waveform lookup. ③ PWM drives the three half-bridge pre-drivers. ④ Current and angle feedback closes the PID loop. F A thermal, overcurrent or overvoltage fault shuts the gates and latches. · dashed boxes are off-chip · pre-silicon architecture; values are design targets
